stderr '^\{"id":7,"name":"x"\}$'

logos run ./g

cd ../gomod

! stdout 'logos/rt/json'

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/probe.lgo --
package main

type Probe struct {
	ID int64 `json:"id"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func main() {
	data, err := (Probe{ID: 7, Name: "x"}).MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	println(string(data))
}

-- w/l/a/a.lgo --
package a

type User struct {
	ID   int64  `json:"id"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

type Profile struct {
	Bio *string `json:"bio"`
}

-- w/l/a/a_test.lgo --
package a_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"example.com/l/a"
)

// These declarations belong to the external test package itself, so its
// imports must be augmented independently of the package under test.
type ExternalBinary struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Float float64 `json:"float"`
	Values []int32 `json:"values"`
	Counts map[string]int64 `json:"counts"`
}

type ExternalWalk struct {
	Value string `json:"value"`
	Next []ExternalWalk `json:"next,omitempty"`
}

func TestExternalGeneratedImports(t *testing.T) {
	value := ExternalBinary{Name: "x", Float: 1.5, Values: []int32{7}, Counts: map[string]int64{"a": 9}}
	data, err := value.MarshalBinary()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
		return
	}
	var got ExternalBinary
	if err := got.UnmarshalBinary(data); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got.Name != "x" || got.Float != 1.5 || len(got.Values) != 1 || got.Values[0] != 7 || (got.Counts["a"] ?? -1) != 9 {
		t.Fatal("binary round trip changed fields")
	}
	wdata, werr := (ExternalWalk{Value: "x"}).MarshalJSON()
	if werr == nil {
		if string(wdata) != `{"value":"x"}` {
			t.Fatalf("got %s", wdata)
		}
	} else {
		t.Fatal(werr)
	}
}

func TestExternalJSON(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(a.User{ID: 1, Name: "n"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(data) != `{"id":1,"name":"n"}` {
		t.Fatalf("got %s", data)
	}
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/main.go --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/a"
)

func main() {
	data, err := json.Marshal(a.User{ID: 7, Name: "x<y"})
	fmt.Printf("%s %v\n", data, err)

	var u a.User
	err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"name":"gone","id":7,"extra":[1]}`), &u)
	fmt.Println(u.ID, u.Name, err)

	var p a.Profile
	err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{}`), &p)
	fmt.Println(err)
}

module example.com/goplain

-- gomod/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("go-ok") }
